title: Vampire Vape Ice Menthol Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Ice Menthol represents Vampire Vape’s ultimate menthol creation, delivering a bold, punchy dose of satisfying menthol that’s clean, crisp, minty and endlessly refreshing. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
